about_the_game:
Cats & Cakes: The Card Game is a cozy 2D cat bakery sim where you stack cards to bake pastries, serve eccentric feline customers, and unlock hidden recipes. Pay your bills, upgrade your tools, and overcome unexpected events to climb the ladder of fame and fortune!

 Mix & Bake!

Every paw-some pastry starts with the purrfect combination of ingredient cards — think Flour, Butter, Chocolate — whisked together with tool cards like Mixer, Ovens, and Piping Bags.
Need a hint? The recipe book’s always there for a sneaky peek! As you bake your way forward, you’ll unlock delightful new recipes, including legendary secret treats.

 Serve Hungry Cats

Drag a ‘Customer’ card onto a ‘Table’ card to reveal their pastry cravings.
Be quick! Feline customers don’t like to wait, and only the fastest paws will deliver their dream desserts before they leave in a huff.

Complete Quests & Earn Rewards

Tackle cozy quests, unlock shiny new recipes, upgrade your bakery tools, or discover an artifact that give your baking station permanent buffs. The more you bake, the more you rise through the whiskered ranks!

Hire Meowchine & Automate the Chaos

Even the busiest baker needs a break! Unlock adorable meowchine — helper that will automatically bake the recipes you choose and serve the selected pastries to waiting customers. No more manual juggling; just set their tasks and watch the treats roll out.

🌍 Multilanguage Support

Enjoy the game in your preferred language! We currently offer support for:

  • English

  • Français (French)

  • 中文 (Chinese)

  • 日本語 (Japanese)

  • 한국어 (Korean)

  • Español (Spanish)

  • Indo (Indonesian)

  • Русский (Russian)

🌟 Rise to Pastry Stardom

Face sudden disasters, impress picky critics, and bake your way to fame! Can you become the most legendary pastry chef in the cat kingdom?
